mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate borrowing costs fall.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows falls below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate above 5.0% indicates labor market weakness that precedes corporate earnings deterioration, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as recession risks rise.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 5.0%, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and rises in inflation (CPIAUCSL) signal a contraction in consumer spending amid high price pressures, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where HOUST declines and CPIAUCSL rises, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansions, a sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) indicates manufacturing weakness that precedes earnings revisions, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of late-cycle expansion periods when INDPRO declines, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rising trend in retail sales (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer spending that drives corporate revenue growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS rises, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows falls below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 4.0% signals restrictive monetary policy that increases corporate borrowing costs and dampens economic activity, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.0%, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in employment (PAYEMS) and unemployment rate (UNRATE) signal labor market distress (e.g., job losses offset by new entrants), leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where PAYEMS rises and UNRATE rises, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In high labor market tightness regimes, a sudden unemployment rate spike (UNRATE > 0.5pp monthly increase) indicates unexpected labor market deterioration that triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE spikes during high labor market tightness, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows falls below 0.03.
